team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

execution.turn_budget_basis: official clock 48 turns vs floor 13 (4 teammates x 2 turns + 1 answer parts + 4 for synthesis)

human_constraints: You must behave like a human teammate under official contest rules.
Do not claim tools, internet, or materials that the rule card forbids.
Do not look up answer keys or hidden solutions.
Exactly one shared team answer sheet for the whole team.
Free collaboration among teammates is allowed.
No calculators, phones, internet, or other electronic devices.
No external dictionaries, notes, or reference materials unless organizers provide them.
Work only from the official problem packet and blank paper.
Write complete answers with enough linguistic justification for marking.
Team contest: members work jointly on one problem set; normally 4 hours; each member gets a copy; team submits a single solution.
Free verbal collaboration within the team room.

Same material/device bans as individual contest: no printed matter/dictionaries; no own paper; no phones/laptops/tablets/smartwatches or outside-world devices; organizer writing paper only; pens preferred.
Artificial aids such as pocket calculators should not be brought (regulations).
Problems on paper; explanations required unless instructed otherwise; one working language for the team solution.

agent_roles.title: data-pattern analyst
duties: Infer patterns from the language data.

agent_roles.name: Agent_3
agent_roles.title: hypothesis tester
duties: Search for counterexamples to proposed mappings.

agent_roles.name: Agent_4
agent_roles.title: verifier and explanation editor
duties: Check every form against the hypothesis.
Make the final explanation complete and readable.

answer_format: Submit the team's final answers in numbered order, using exact values when required.
rules_text: International Linguistics Olympiad — Team Contest. The active team of 4 works the problem set together and turns in one shared answer sheet. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. The team files one shared submission. Official timing note: About 4 hours for the team contest.
